channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Craig Sager | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Craig Sager from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Craig Sager
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Craig Sager:

“He loved all the people around it (the NBA), and everybody felt that.”

Gregg Popovich on Craig Sager, Dec 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Craig Sager
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Craig Sager:

“He was a way better person than he was a worker, even though he was amazing in that regard.”

Gregg Popovich on Craig Sager, Dec 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Craig Sager
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Craig Sager:

“If any of us can display half the courage he has to stay on this planet...we would be well off.”

Gregg Popovich on Craig Sager, Dec 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Craig Sager
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Sager:

“What he has endured, the fight he put up, the courage he displayed during the situation is beyond my comprehension.”

Gregg Popovich on Craig Sager, Dec 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Craig Sager
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Jason Kidd on Sager:

“He’s a true legend, a pioneer. Our prayers go out to his family. He was part of the fabric of our game.”

Jason Kidd on Craig Sager, Dec 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Craig Sager
item.description:
Nate Taylor:Nate McMillan on Craig Sager:

“To me, he was sunshine. When you saw Craig, he puts a smile on your face when you were interviewed by him.”

Nate McMillan on Craig Sager, Dec 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByNateTaylor.
